description.narrative: FSDAi is seeking to invest up to £8 million in a wholly owned SPV for onward investment into 4-7 Alternative Local Capital Providers (ALCPs). The SPV will enter a management contract with Nyala Venture (NV), a joint venture of Cardano Development and Total Impact Capital for the management of the investment process into the ALCPs.

FSDAi sets up an SPV and funds it through capital calls of up to GBP 8m. The SPV then enters into a management agreement with NV and eventually financing agreements with ALCPs for debt and equity investments. The ALCPs apply the investment capital to invest in SGBs. The SPV may also offer financial support directly to ALCPs to meet operating expenses. The ALCPs are structured in innovative ways to provide capital better suited to SGBs.

activity-date.narrative: FNF invest in structures that facilitate either self-liquidation or structured equity exits.
This is the date of FSDAi signing the Management Agreement

sector.narrative: Risk capital to enable emerging local capital providers serving small and growing businesses in Africa to test new funding models and attract capital thereafter.
